theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (G : Euclid 2 → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid 2)) (t α : ℝ), IsOpen S → !₂[t, α] ∈ S → (∀ w ∈ S, G w = w 0 • γ (w 1)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ γ α → t ≠ 0 → Set.range (fderiv ℝ G !₂[t, α]) = (Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α} : Set (Euclid P))
